evidence: In2O3:H ﬁlms of 75 nm thickness were prepared using an ALD process that is based on the work of Libera et al.,6 i.e., using cyclopentadienyl indium (InCp) as the indium source and a combination of O2 and H2O as oxidant. All depositions were carried out in an Oxford Instruments OpAL ALD reactor.
